method: ENTIRELY from AMH across four pages, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED: no passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable. A targeted search of RACGP's open AJGP found one relevant article -- 'Current approaches to the pharmacological treatment of dementia' -- dated SEPTEMBER 2018. It was NOT USED. Eight years is too old for the one part of this field that has moved furthest, anti-amyloid therapy, and using it would have meant presenting a 2018 position on a 2026 question. That decision is recorded rather than hidden. AMH's own July 2026 position on anti-amyloid therapy is reported as AMH states it, and flagged as time_sensitive.
